name: v-code
description: V-Code: an AI voice-first coding assistant for visually impaired learners

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json
